result.topic_en: Diary entries from Gauss's mathematical diary (1797–1799) recording results on the lemniscate, a ballistic problem, the theory of comets, higher forms, parallax formulas, the arithmetic-geometric mean, and the principles of geometry.
result.transcription:
De lemniscata, elegantissima omnes exspectati-
ones superantia acquisivimus et quidem
per methodos quae campum prorsus
novum nobis aperiunt. Gott. Jul.
# Solutio problematis ballistici Gott Jul
# Cometarum theoriam perfectiorem reddidi Gott Jul
Novus in analysi campus se nobis aperuit,
scilicet investigatio functionum etc. [-Oct-][?]
# Formas superiores considerare coepimus
Br. Febr. 14 1799
Formulas novas exactas pro parallaxi
eruimus ———————— Br. Apr. 8.
# Terminum medium arithmetico-geometricum
inter 1 et $\sqrt{2}$ esse $= \frac{\pi}{\varpi}$ usque
ad figuram undecimam comprobavimus, qua re
demonstrata prorsus novus campus in analysi
certo aperietur Br. Mai 30.
# In principiis Geometriae egregios progressus
fecimus Br. Sept.
# Circa terminos medios arithmetico-geometricos
multa nova deteximus. Br. Novemb.

methods.what: Numerical verification that the arithmetic-geometric mean of 1 and sqrt(2) equals pi/varpi to 11 digits
methods.quote:
Terminum medium arithmetico-geometricum
inter 1 et $\sqrt{2}$ esse $= \frac{\pi}{\varpi}$ usque
ad figuram undecimam comprobavimus

Circa terminos medios arithmetico-geometricos
multa nova deteximus

items.quote:
Terminum medium arithmetico-geometricum
inter 1 et $\sqrt{2}$ esse $= \frac{\pi}{\varpi}$ usque

items.english: We have verified to the eleventh figure that the arithmetic-geometric mean between 1 and √2 is = π/ϖ; once this is demonstrated, an entirely new field in analysis will certainly be opened.

items.quote:
Novus in analysi campus se nobis aperuit,
scilicet investigatio functionum etc.
items.english: A new field in analysis has opened itself to us, namely the investigation of functions etc.

items.quote:
In principiis Geometriae egregios progressus
fecimus
items.english: We have made excellent progress in the foundations of geometry.
